text:
Hector M: Received invoice SK-8723 from Skyline Software for $22,750. PDF includes two PO numbers in different places (PO-66210 in header, PO-66211 in line detail). OCR matched header PO only.

Lina K: Can you paste invoice number and vendor ref? Also which cost centers?

Hector M: Invoice SK-8723, vendor ref SL-2026-77. Lines look like Platform vs Research split but vendor put a single total and didn't break amounts by PO. CCs: Platform=CC-210, Research=CC-409.

finance-bot: Automated alert: SK-8723 flagged "multi_po_unsplit". Suggested actions: 1) request vendor reissue two invoices (one per PO) or 2) provide signed allocation schedule + AP confirmation for manual split.

Amir S: If vendor can't reissue, AP can manual-split but we need: vendor allocation signed, approver for each CC, and FX details if currency differs. Also need original invoice number referenced on both split records for audit.

Skyline Billing: Hi Hector  sorry about that. Our system grouped subscriptions and accidentally used header PO only. We can: a) reissue two invoices SK-8723A and SK-8723B (one per PO) with amounts, or b) provide a vendor allocation sheet signed by billing manager. Which works?

Hector M: Prefer reissue A/B so GL is clean. Can you include line-level detail matched to PO lines and keep original invoice date? Also include a small note "reissue of SK-8723".

Lina K: Also confirm currency. The PO-66210 is in USD, PO-66211 is in EUR. If vendor reissues in mixed currencies, AP needs conversion notes. If they reissue both in USD we'll need exchange rate and vendor signature.

Skyline Billing: We can do SK-8723A billed USD for PO-66210 and SK-8723B billed EUR for PO-66211. We'll include exchange rate note on the EUR invoice (convert to USD at invoice date rate) and include VAT ID for EU lines. Reissue ETA: EOD today.

AP Queue: From AP: prefer two reissued PDFs. If one invoice remains, require signed allocation + approver attestation for both CCs. Set hold on SK-8723 until resolved.

Amir S: Approvers: CC-210 -> @Lina K; CC-409 -> @Priya S (not in thread). Lina please confirm you'll approve Platform portion once reissued.

Lina K: I'll approve Platform side once SK-8723A shows PO-66210 and CC-210. Leaving note on PO-66210: "Awaiting vendor reissue SK-8723A; approval pending."

Skyline Billing: Uploaded SK-8723A.pdf (USD, PO-66210) and SK-8723B.pdf (EUR, PO-66211) to portal: https://files.skyline.example/SK-8723A.pdf, https://files.skyline.example/SK-8723B.pdf

finance-bot: Files received. OCR: SK-8723A matched PO-66210, SK-8723B matched PO-66211. Detected currencies USD and EUR. Suggested actions: auto-match SK-8723A to PO-66210; SK-8723B manual-split with FX note for EUR convert.

AP Queue: AP action: SK-8723A -> auto-match and route to approver Lina K. SK-8723B -> create invoice record with EUR amount and attached FX conversion note, route to approver Priya S. Payment hold remains until approvals.

Hector M: Thanks all. Lina please confirm approval when you see SK-8723A.

Lina K: Approved SK-8723A. Left ProcureLink comment: "Approved Platform lines. Vendor reissue SK-8723B EUR verified." :white_check_mark:

finance-bot: SK-8723A status = approved_by_Lina; SK-8723B status = awaiting_approval_Priya_S. Due date for vendor follow-up if no approval: 3 business days (2064304140).

Amir S: Once Priya approves, AP please post GL entries and close the original SK-8723 record as reissued. Note audit cross-ref SK-8723 -> SK-8723A/B.

Skyline Billing: Thanks everyone. We'll send a signed allocation statement linking all docs to the original invoice number for audit. Apologies for the trouble.

finance-bot: Thread recorded: SK-8723 handled as reissue split. Closing once SK-8723B approval received.
